content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-427. - I.P.C. Section 909.1, Distance of trap from vent.
content.summary:
Section 9091. Distance of trap from vent,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"
909.1. Distance of trap from vent.
Each fixture trap shall have a protecting vent located and installed in conformance
                  with the requirements of the Colorado Plumbing Code."
